nodes.name: Write JSON File
nodes.notes: Enable and set a path writable by your n8n process. The standalone runner writes to ./output by default.

nodes.name: Google Sheets (swap-in)
nodes.notes: Disabled by default. Connect Google Sheets credentials, set document ID, then enable. Feed items from Merge Analysis instead of Build JSON & CSV if preferred.

nodes.name: Airtable (swap-in)
nodes.notes: Disabled by default. Connect Airtable credentials, set base/table IDs, then enable.
